Pet hair all over your sofa and coat?

Cat and dog hair cling to sofas, coats and sweaters, and sticky rollers run out of sheets just when you need them. This reusable lint brush lifts pet hair and dust in a few strokes, with no sticky sheets to buy again. Fur-free clothes and a cleaner sofa, every day.

• About 21 x 5.5 cm (8.3 x 2.2 in), red and white with an easy-grip handle
• No sticky sheets: reusable again and again
• Brush in one direction, then wipe the hair off the pad

Link in the first comment. ¥980 (about $6 USD).
